pr_title: security: fixes CertificateLoader tests when running as root
pr_body:
This change fixes the CertificateLoader tests when running as the
root user, since the acceptable permissions change depending on
what user owns the certificate files (which is root since the tests
create the certificate files).

Closes #68485

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/68511)

I wasn't certain if the Bazel CI check was failing because of a change that I made in this PR but it appears to be showing up in other PRs aside from this one. Assuming the tests pass again, I'll submit this to be merged!
This PR was included in a batch that was canceled, it will be automatically retried
